key_insight: This Alzheimer’s MRI study—not cancer drug discovery—combines four-stage classification with EigenGradCAM and AugSmooth to improve model explainability.
clinical_relevance: The approach may support interpretable Alzheimer’s staging research, but clinical utility remains unvalidated.
method: Train custom CNNs on 2D axial MRI images for four-class staging.
Use WGAN-GP synthetic samples to address Moderate Dementia class imbalance.
Combine eigenvector-based Grad-CAM with gradient smoothing to stabilize saliency maps.
evidence_signal: On the Best Alzheimer MRI Dataset, the study reports 97.2% test accuracy, 97.0% balanced accuracy, MCC 0.944, and class-wise ROC AUCs of 0.96–0.99.
watch_item: Further clinical validation is needed; anatomically plausible heatmaps alone do not establish reliable clinical reasoning.
paper_title: EigenGradCAM with AugSmooth: Enhancing Explainability and Precision in Multi-Stage Alzheimer's Disease Detection
